highlights_headline: This unreleased servicing line backports Apple 26.0 TFM support and fixes a WinUI DLL loading regression.

bullets.lead: Apple 26.0 library and unversioned app TFMs backported
bullets.detail: The 3.119.x line now supports building against the Apple 26.0 SDKs with unversioned application target framework monikers.

bullets.lead: WinUI Projection DLL resolved for .NET 9 consumers
bullets.detail: Fixed a missing WinUI Projection DLL that caused load failures for apps targeting .NET 9.

contributor_summaries.drasticactions: Backported Apple 26.0 library and unversioned app TFM support to the 3.119.x line.
